status: Native local validation of staged batch uploads; this exact runtime was subsequently deployed and exercised through native Cloudflare bindings.
change: Rust applies each ordered write to a request-private kernel; Effect deduplicates required immutable blocks across the batch and uploads with concurrency four before one conditional head publication. Single writes retain prepare/upload/apply ordering.

validation.completeGate: bun run check passed: build, SDK declarations, TypeScript, workspace Clippy, workspace Cargo tests and native Bun tests.
validation.changedBoundary: Native R2/workerd preserves hard-link write ordering, per-entry errors, shared content, a single generation increment, exactly 16 MiB aggregate content and unchanged state after rejecting 16 MiB plus one byte. Existing native integration tests cover guest batch tools, grants, same-path updates and concurrent publication conflicts.
validation.exactArchiveProof: bun run package:proof passed against the final exact candidate archives after SDK documentation was refreshed: public exports/declarations, native service binding, snapshots/hard links, Agent RPC callbacks, reclamation and persistent-driver authority/cancellation.

minuteiCompatibility.transport: native workerd Agent service binding; actual Minutei Code Mode and tenant SQLite; local R2, KV and Queue

validation.minuteiLimits: Actual consumer fixtures passed with installed SDK 0.9.0 and native tenant SQLite. The native history Queue had no consumer; authenticated application, model behavior and production Minutei were not tested.
validation.format: bun run format:check passed; final maintained evidence formatting is checked again before commit.
validation.generalBenchmark: bun run bench passed; current native results are maintained in docs/evidence/performance-local.json, separate from the paired batch comparison.

benchmark.environment: local native Alchemy workerd; runtime module directories; fresh R2 per phase; sequential ABBA then BAAB
benchmark.workload: 128 new files with distinct small contents per request; four warmups and twelve timed samples per phase; ordered acknowledgements and three sampled contents verified; nearest-rank quantiles

limits: Local shared-host workerd/R2 latency, not Cloudflare production latency or cost.
Large phase-to-phase host variation; one current phase has a higher p95 than either adjacent reference phase. All samples are retained.
Concurrency and hash deduplication are enforced by source; no R2 bill or remote request counter was measured.
The new block map can retain up to the existing 16 MiB decoded batch bound. Peak Worker memory has not been measured.
Infrastructure failure or ETag conflict leaves the old published head; uploaded orphan blocks may remain.
No Rust binary change; existing native write validation and upload-plan output are reused.
archiveAuditLimit: Expected archive paths and exact Apache-2.0 licenses; no env/node_modules entries or exact configured control credential. This is not a general secret or dependency-license audit.

delivery.github: Deferred at user direction; no authentication or publication attempted.
delivery.productionPlan: Native Alchemy profile minutei, stage prod: existing Sandbox update and unconditional Migrations task. R2, Queue, consumer and bindings unchanged. No Dynamic Workers or Worker Loader.
